params.caption: 🖥️ AMD to fix driver utility blamed for wearing down SSDs Users report that a misbehaving utility bundled with AMD's GPU drivers is cutting SSD health by around 1% per month. AMD says a fix is on the way in an upcoming driver update, so Radeon owners should keep an eye out for it. 🕒 Nov 9, 2026 · 20:15 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer #AMD #Radeon #GamingNews
